scientific_integrity: The exact finite-rate survival law and the first-moment discontinuity are acknowledged as prior work. This manuscript makes no independent audit or experimental validation claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes independent Poisson recruitment, exponential mortality, fixed positive rate ratios, one initial viable searcher, and an exponentially integrable bare first-passage time. No heavy-tailed, correlated, or non-Poisson extension is proved.
title: Rare-survivor exponential clock and moment bifurcation under weak synthesis–degradation
